image_note: Pictures are artistic illustrations, not photos.

en.name: Humo Arena
en.history: Opened in March 2019, Humo Arena gave Tashkent a major venue for ice hockey, figure skating and large public events. Its opening marked an investment in Uzbekistan’s winter sports.
en.see: Look for the arena’s sweeping silhouette. Depending on the programme, you may find a match, competition or stage show.
en.tip: Check the organiser’s event calendar and ticket information before you go.

uz.name: Humo Arena
uz.history: 2019-yil martida ochilgan Humo Arena Toshkentdagi muz sporti va ommaviy tadbirlar majmuasidir. Uning ochilishi mamlakatda xokkey va figurali uchishni rivojlantirishga xizmat qilgan.
uz.see: Arena dasturida sport musobaqalari va sahna tadbirlari bo‘lishi mumkin. Bino silueti zamonaviy Toshkent me’morchiligining namunasi.
uz.tip: Safarni tanlagan tadbiringizga moslang. Chipta, kirish va tadbir vaqtini tashkilotchidan tekshiring.

en.name: Hazrati Imam
en.history: This ensemble grew around the tomb of Abu Bakr Qaffal Shashi, a scholar associated with historic Tashkent. Madrasas, a mausoleum and a mosque represent different periods of the city’s religious life.
en.see: Look for the Barak-Khan Madrasa portal, Qaffal Shashi’s mausoleum and the Muyi Muborak Madrasa.
en.tip: Dress respectfully and check visitor access around prayer times.

uz.name: Hazrati Imom
uz.history: Majmua toshkentlik olim Abu Bakr Qaffol Shoshiy qabri atrofida shakllangan. Hududda turli davrlarga mansub madrasalar, maqbara va masjid mavjud.
uz.see: Baroqxon madrasasining peshtoqini, Qaffol Shoshiy maqbarasini va Mo‘yi Muborak madrasasini ko‘ring. Majmua Eski shaharning diniy tarixini anglashga yordam beradi.
uz.tip: Ibodat joylariga mos kiyining. Namoz va tashrif tartibini joyida aniqlang.

en.name: Charvak Dam
en.history: Built near the confluence of the Chatkal and Pskem rivers, the dam created a reservoir that forms part of the Chirchiq basin’s water and power infrastructure.
en.see: From an open viewpoint, take in the reservoir, the dam and the slopes of the western Tian Shan in a single panorama.
en.tip: Use designated public viewpoints and check road conditions before setting out.

uz.name: Chorvoq to‘g‘oni
uz.history: To‘g‘on Chatqol va Piskom daryolari tutashadigan tog‘li hududda qurilgan. Suv ombori Chirchiq havzasidagi suv xo‘jaligi va energetika tizimining bir qismidir.
uz.see: Ochiq tomosha nuqtalaridan suv ombori, g‘arbiy Tyanshan yonbag‘irlari va to‘g‘on ko‘lamini birgalikda ko‘rish mumkin.
uz.tip: Ruxsat etilgan tomosha nuqtalarini tanlang va yo‘l holatini tekshiring.

en.name: Amirsoy
en.history: Opened in 2019 near Chimgan, Amirsoy serves winter skiers and snowboarders with groomed slopes and gondola, chair and conveyor lifts.
en.see: Ski or snowboard in winter, or take the gondola for mountain views when the lifts are operating outside ski season.
en.tip: Check the resort’s lift and slope status alongside the weather forecast.

uz.name: Amirsoy
uz.history: Chimgan yaqinidagi Amirsoy 2019-yilda ochilgan. Kurortda gondola, kresloli va konveyerli ko‘targichlar bor. Qishki yo‘laklar chang‘i va snoubord uchun mo‘ljallangan.
uz.see: Qishda chang‘i uchish, qor bo‘lmagan mavsumda esa gondoladan tog‘ manzarasini tomosha qilish mumkin.
uz.tip: Ishlayotgan ko‘targichlar, yo‘laklar holati va ob-havoni kurort saytida tekshiring.

en.name: Registan Square
en.history: Three madrasas frame the square: Ulugh Beg, Sher-Dor and Tilla-Kari. Ulugh Beg’s madrasa dates to the 15th century. The other two were added later.
en.see: Compare Ulugh Beg’s geometric patterns, the animals on Sher-Dor’s portal and Tilla-Kari’s gilded interior.
en.tip: Start in the square to see all three façades, then take time to explore their courtyards and details.

uz.name: Registon maydoni
uz.history: Registonning uch tomonida Ulug‘bek, Sherdor va Tillakori madrasalari joylashgan. Ulug‘bek madrasasi XV asrga mansub, qolgan ikki madrasa keyinroq ansamblni to‘ldirgan.
uz.see: Sherdor peshtoqidagi jonivor tasvirlari, Ulug‘bek madrasasining geometrik bezaklari va Tillakorining zarhal ichki bezaklariga e’tibor bering.
uz.tip: Avval maydon markazidan uch fasadni birga ko‘ring, so‘ng hovli va bezaklarni yaqindan kuzating.

en.name: Shah-i-Zinda
en.history: Set against the Afrasiab hillside, Shah-i-Zinda is a stepped avenue of mausoleums and one of the principal monuments in UNESCO-listed historic Samarkand.
en.see: Follow the succession of portals and look closely at the blue tilework, glazed relief and inscriptions.
en.tip: Wear shoes suited to steps and give worshippers space when taking photographs.

uz.name: Shohi Zinda
uz.history: Afrosiyob yonbag‘ridagi Shohi Zinda zinapoyali yo‘lak bo‘ylab joylashgan maqbaralar majmuasidir. U UNESCO ro‘yxatidagi tarixiy Samarqandning muhim obidalaridan biri.
uz.see: Moviy koshinlar, o‘yma sirlangan bezaklar va yozuvlar bir yo‘lakda turli me’moriy yechimlarni ko‘rsatadi. Peshtoqlarni ketma-ket kuzating.
uz.tip: Zinapoyali yo‘lakka mos poyabzal kiying. Ziyoratchilarga xalaqit bermasdan suratga oling.

en.name: Poi Kalon
en.history: The ensemble brings together the Kalon Minaret, Kalon Mosque and Mir-i Arab Madrasa. The minaret was built in 1127 during the reign of the Qarakhanid ruler Arslan Khan.
en.see: Notice the patterned brick bands on the minaret and how the mosque and madrasa portals face one another across the square.
en.tip: Compare the façades from the square and check access rules before entering religious buildings.

uz.name: Poi Kalon
uz.history: Ansambl Kalon minorasi, Kalon masjidi va Mir Arab madrasasini birlashtiradi. Qoraxoniy hukmdori Arslonxon davrida qurilgan minora 1127-yilga mansub.
uz.see: Minoraning naqshli g‘isht belbog‘lari va bir-biriga qaragan masjid hamda madrasa peshtoqlari maydonning asosiy ko‘rinishini yaratadi.
uz.tip: Fasadlarni maydondan solishtiring. Masjid va madrasa uchun tashrif qoidalarini tekshiring.

en.name: Lyabi-Hauz
en.history: Lyabi-Hauz takes its name from the pool at the heart of the ensemble. Nearby buildings include the Nadir Divan-Begi Madrasa and khanqah, and the Kukeldash Madrasa.
en.see: Walk the shaded perimeter and look for the Nadir Divan-Begi portal. The pool and surrounding buildings show how public life and trade converged in old Bukhara.
en.tip: Include it in an Old City walking route and pause at different sides of the pool.

uz.name: Labi Hovuz
uz.history: Labi Hovuz nomi hovuz bo‘yidagi ansamblga ishora qiladi. Hovuz atrofida Nodir Devonbegi madrasasi va xonaqohi hamda Ko‘kaldosh madrasasi joylashgan.
uz.see: Suv bo‘yidagi soyali maydon tarixiy Buxoroda savdo va jamoat hayoti qanday tutashganini ko‘rsatadi. Nodir Devonbegi madrasasi peshtoqini ko‘ring.
uz.tip: Eski shahar bo‘ylab piyoda sayrga qo‘shing. Hovuzni turli tomonlardan tomosha qiling.

en.name: Kalta Minor
en.history: Muhammad Amin Khan commissioned this minaret beside his madrasa. Construction stopped in 1855 after his death, leaving Khiva with its distinctive broad, low tower.
en.see: Look for the turquoise glazed tiles and compare their pattern with the decoration on the neighbouring madrasa portal.
en.tip: Enter the walled city via the West Gate and visit Kalta Minor on foot.

uz.name: Kalta Minor
uz.history: Muhammad Aminxon buyurtma qilgan minora yonidagi madrasa bilan bir ansambl hosil qiladi. Xon vafot etgach, qurilish 1855-yilda to‘xtagan.
uz.see: Keng asos va moviy sirlangan koshinlar minoraning tanish siluetini yaratadi. Naqshlarni madrasa peshtoqi bilan solishtiring.
uz.tip: Ichan qal’aga Ota darvoza tomonidan kirib, minorani piyoda marshrutga qo‘shing.

en.name: Itchan Kala
en.history: Khiva’s inner town was a caravan stop before the desert crossing toward Persia. UNESCO added the walled city to the World Heritage List in 1990.
en.see: See the West Gate, Kunya Ark, the wooden columns of the Juma Mosque and the courtyards of Tash Hauli Palace.
en.tip: Explore on foot and confirm which museums or courtyards require tickets at the entrance.

uz.name: Ichan qal’a
uz.history: Ichan qal’a Xivaning ichki shahri bo‘lib, cho‘l orqali Eronga yo‘l olgan karvonlar uchun muhim bekat bo‘lgan. UNESCO uni 1990-yilda Jahon merosi ro‘yxatiga kiritgan.
uz.see: Ota darvoza, Ko‘hna Ark, Juma masjidining yog‘och ustunlari va Toshhovli saroyi turli davrlarning shahar hayotini ochib beradi.
uz.tip: Ichki shaharni piyoda aylaning. Muzeylar va ichki hovlilarning chipta tartibini kirishda aniqlang.

en.name: Khudayor Khan Palace
en.history: Commissioned by Khudayor Khan, the palace reflects the court architecture of the Kokand Khanate. Uzbekistan’s tourism portal identifies it as the ruler’s seventh palace.
en.see: Look for the colourful tiled entrance, decorated doors and windows, and the courtyards behind the main portal.
en.tip: Pair the palace with Kokand’s Jami Mosque and a walk through the old town.

uz.name: Xudoyorxon saroyi
uz.history: Qo‘qon xoni Xudoyorxon bunyod ettirgan bu o‘rda xonlik davrining saroy me’morchiligini aks ettiradi. Turizm portali uni hukmdorning yettinchi saroyi sifatida ta’riflaydi.
uz.see: Rangli koshinli peshtoq, deraza va eshik bezaklari hamda hovlilar saroyning tantanali qiyofasini yaratadi.
uz.tip: Saroy tashrifini Qo‘qondagi Jome masjidi va eski shahar bo‘ylab sayr bilan bog‘lang.

en.name: Rishtan Ceramics
en.history: Rishtan is one of the Fergana Valley’s pottery centres. Local workshops offer a view of shaping, decorating, glazing and firing. Uzbekistan’s ceramic arts entered UNESCO’s intangible heritage list in 2023.
en.see: Compare the blue and green patterns on bowls and platters, and look at how different motifs are painted.
en.tip: Arrange a workshop visit in advance and ask a potter to explain the glaze and firing process.

uz.name: Rishton kulolchiligi
uz.history: Rishton vodiy kulolchilik maktablaridan biri. Ustaxonalar loyni shakllantirish, naqsh solish, sirlash va xumdonda pishirish jarayonlarini ko‘rish imkonini beradi.
uz.see: Moviy va yashil naqshli lagan hamda kosalarni solishtiring. O‘zbekiston kulolchilik san’ati 2023-yilda UNESCO nomoddiy meros ro‘yxatiga kiritilgan.
uz.tip: Ustaxona tashrifini oldindan kelishing. Ustadan naqsh, sir va pishirish bosqichlarini tushuntirib berishini so‘rang.

en.name: Jami Complex
en.history: Dating to the 19th century, the Jami Complex brings together a madrasa, minaret and other religious structures in Andijan’s historic quarter.
en.see: Look closely at the portal, minaret and interior decoration. The nearby Devonaboy Mosque can be visited on the same route.
en.tip: Ask locally about interior access and give people space during worship.

uz.name: Jome majmuasi
uz.history: Andijonning Eski shahar qismidagi XIX asr Jome majmuasi madrasa, minora va diniy inshootlarni birlashtiradi. U vodiy shaharlarining tarixiy diniy hayotini aks ettiradi.
uz.see: Peshtoq, minora va ichki bezaklarni kuzating. Yaqindagi Devonaboy masjidi bilan bir yo‘nalishda ko‘rish mumkin.
uz.tip: Tashrif davomida ibodat qiluvchilarga joy bering. Ichki qismlarga kirish tartibini joyida so‘rang.

en.name: Babur Memorial Park
en.history: On Bogishamol Hill, the park commemorates Zahir al-Din Muhammad Babur, who was born in Andijan. Soil was brought from Agra, where he died, and Kabul, where he was buried.
en.see: See the memorial and hilltop views, then combine the visit with the museum devoted to Babur.
en.tip: Plan your transport back to central Andijan and allow time for a walk around the hill.

uz.name: Bobur memorial bog‘i
uz.history: Bog‘ishamol tepaligidagi bog‘ Andijonda tug‘ilgan Zahiriddin Muhammad Boburga bag‘ishlangan. Majmua uchun Bobur vafot etgan Agra va dafn etilgan Kobuldan tuproq keltirilgan.
uz.see: Yodgorlik, bog‘ yo‘laklari va tepalikdan ochiladigan manzarani ko‘ring. Tashrifni Bobur haqidagi muzey bilan bog‘lash mumkin.
uz.tip: Shahar markazidan borish va qaytish transportini rejalashtiring. Tepalik bo‘ylab piyoda sayrga vaqt ajrating.

en.name: Mulla Kyrgyz Madrasa
en.history: Built in the early 20th century near Chorsu Bazaar, this madrasa offers a glimpse of Namangan’s historic centre and its brick architecture.
en.see: Notice the corner towers, decorated brick portal and former student cells.
en.tip: Combine the madrasa and bazaar on a short walk. Check locally whether workshops are open.

uz.name: Mulla Qirg‘iz madrasasi
uz.history: Chorsu bozori yaqinidagi madrasa XX asr boshiga mansub. U Namanganning eski shahar muhiti va mahalliy g‘isht me’morchiligi bilan tanishtiradi.
uz.see: Burchak minoralari, bezakli g‘ishtin peshtoq va sobiq hujralarga e’tibor bering. Madrasa bilan bozor yonma-yon joylashgan.
uz.tip: Madrasa va Chorsuni bitta piyoda marshrutga birlashtiring. Ustaxonalar faoliyatini joyida aniqlang.

en.name: Chartak
en.history: In the Chartaksoy Valley, Chartak is known for its mineral water and sanatoriums. Its foothill setting puts orchards and valley scenery within reach of Namangan.
en.see: Explore the valley roads and gardens, or learn how mineral water became part of the local resort tradition.
en.tip: Ask your chosen sanatorium directly about day access, reservations and available services.

uz.name: Chortoq
uz.history: Chortoqsoy vodiysidagi Chortoq mineral suvi va sanatoriylari bilan tanilgan. Tog‘oldi muhiti shahar tashqarisida dam olish uchun qulay manzara yaratadi.
uz.see: Vodiy yo‘llari, bog‘lar va mineral suv bilan bog‘liq mahalliy dam olish madaniyati bilan tanishing.
uz.tip: Sanatoriyga boradigan bo‘lsangiz, kunlik tashrif, bron va xizmatlar shartlarini bevosita so‘rang.

en.name: Ak-Saray Palace Ruins
en.history: Built under Amir Timur, Ak-Saray survives mainly in the two towering sides of its entrance portal. It is a principal monument of the historic centre of Shahrisabz.
en.see: Study the surviving tile patterns and stand back to appreciate the scale of the original entrance.
en.tip: View the portal from across the approach, then continue on foot to Dorut Tilovat.

uz.name: Oqsaroy qoldiqlari
uz.history: Amir Temur davrida bunyod etilgan Oqsaroydan ulkan kirish peshtog‘ining ikki yon qismi saqlangan. Saroy Shahrisabz tarixiy markazining asosiy obidalaridan.
uz.see: Qoldiqlardagi koshin naqshlari va peshtoqning hozirgi ko‘lami saroyning avvalgi ulug‘vorligi haqida tasavvur beradi.
uz.tip: Peshtoqni qarama-qarshi tomondan tomosha qiling, so‘ng Dorut Tilovatga piyoda boring.

en.name: Dorut Tilovat
en.history: This Timurid ensemble includes the Kok Gumbaz Mosque, commissioned by Ulugh Beg, and historic mausoleums around a shared courtyard.
en.see: Look for the blue dome, mosque portal and the way the surrounding buildings frame the courtyard.
en.tip: Visit after Ak-Saray and check local rules for photography and access to sacred spaces.

uz.name: Dorut Tilovat
uz.history: Dorut Tilovat Shahrisabzdagi Temuriylar davri yodgorliklaridan. Majmuada Mirzo Ulug‘bek buyurtma qilgan Ko‘k Gumbaz masjidi va tarixiy maqbaralar bor.
uz.see: Moviy gumbaz, masjid peshtog‘i va hovli atrofidagi inshootlar birgalikda davr me’morchiligini namoyon etadi.
uz.tip: Oqsaroydan keyin tashrif buyuring. Ziyorat va suratga olish qoidalarini joyida tekshiring.

en.name: Sultan Saodat
en.history: The burial place of the Sayyids of Termez took shape over several centuries. Its surviving mausoleums reflect different building phases through the 17th century.
en.see: Follow the courtyard to study brick portals, the iwan and the placement of the mausoleums. Fired brick is a defining material here.
en.tip: Combine it with the Termez Archaeological Museum for a broader view of the area’s history.

uz.name: Sulton Saodat
uz.history: Termiz sayyidlari dafn etilgan bu majmua bir necha asr davomida shakllangan. Saqlangan maqbaralar o‘rta asrlardan XVII asrgacha bo‘lgan qurilish bosqichlarini aks ettiradi.
uz.see: G‘ishtin peshtoqlar, ayvon va maqbaralarning hovliga nisbatan joylashuvini kuzating. Bezakda pishiq g‘isht muhim o‘rin tutadi.
uz.tip: Tashrifni Termiz arxeologiya muzeyi bilan bog‘lasangiz, hudud tarixini kengroq tushunasiz.

en.name: Boysun
en.history: Boysun’s mountain communities have preserved local songs, ceremonies and crafts across generations. UNESCO recognises the cultural space of Boysun District as intangible heritage.
en.see: A local guide can help you explore village life and mountain routes with context about the customs you encounter.
en.tip: Check road and trail conditions. Ask permission before photographing people or ceremonies.

uz.name: Boysun
uz.history: Boysun tumani tog‘li manzarasi va avlodlar davomida saqlangan marosim, qo‘shiq hamda hunarmandchilik an’analari bilan ajralib turadi.
uz.see: UNESCO Boysun madaniy makonini nomoddiy meros sifatida tan olgan. Mahalliy gid bilan qishloq hayoti va tog‘ yo‘llari bilan tanishing.
uz.tip: Tog‘ yo‘llari holatini tekshiring. Odamlar va marosimlarni suratga olishdan oldin ruxsat so‘rang.

en.name: Jizzakh Railway Station
en.history: Jizzakh appears in Uzbekistan Railways’ official booking system. The station serves the city and provides a starting point for onward travel around the region.
en.see: If you are heading into the mountains, factor in a separate road transfer from the railway station.
en.tip: Use the official rail booking site to confirm whether the train stops in Jizzakh on your travel date.

uz.name: Jizzax temiryo‘l vokzali
uz.history: Jizzax O‘zbekiston temir yo‘llarining rasmiy chipta tizimida mavjud shahar. Vokzal Jizzax shahri va viloyat bo‘ylab keyingi yo‘nalishlarga o‘tish nuqtasidir.
uz.see: Jizzaxdan tog‘ hududlariga sayohatni rejalashtirsangiz, vokzaldan keyingi avtomobil qatnovini alohida hisobga oling.
uz.tip: Aniq kun va yo‘nalish bo‘yicha poyezd to‘xtashini rasmiy chipta tizimida tekshiring.

en.name: Zaamin National Park
en.history: The national park covers part of the northern slope of the Turkestan Range in Zaamin and Bakhmal districts. Juniper forests are a defining feature of its mountain landscape.
en.see: Look for open trails, shaded valleys and viewpoints across the ridges.
en.tip: Confirm weather, entry rules and open routes before travelling. Arrange return transport in advance.

uz.name: Zomin milliy tabiat bog‘i
uz.history: Milliy bog‘ Turkiston tizmasining shimoliy yonbag‘rida, Zomin va Baxmal tumanlarida joylashgan. Tog‘ yonbag‘irlaridagi archa o‘rmonlari hududning asosiy tabiiy belgilaridan.
uz.see: Archa orasidagi ochiq yo‘laklar, tog‘ panoramasi va salqin vodiylar tabiat sayri uchun qiziqarli.
uz.tip: Ob-havo, kirish tartibi va ochiq marshrutlarni oldindan tekshiring. Qaytish transportini kelishib oling.

en.name: Yogochli Sardoba
en.history: This cistern on an old caravan route across the Mirzachul steppe collected and stored water. Its fired-brick dome sheltered the water supply in an arid landscape.
en.see: Notice the dome, entrance and how the structure sits against the surrounding ground.
en.tip: Confirm access locally. If the interior is closed, you can still study the building from outside.

uz.name: Yog‘ochli sardoba
uz.history: Mirzacho‘ldagi qadimiy karvon yo‘lida joylashgan sardoba suv yig‘ish va saqlash uchun xizmat qilgan. Gumbazli pishiq g‘isht inshooti quruq dasht sharoitiga mos qurilgan.
uz.see: Gumbaz, kirish qismi va inshootning yerga nisbatan joylashuviga e’tibor bering. Bu Gumbaz qishlog‘idagi suv inshootidir.
uz.tip: Mahalliy kirish sharoitini aniqlang. Ichki qism yopiq bo‘lsa, tashqaridan tomosha qiling.

en.name: Syr Darya Riverbank
en.history: The Syr Darya is one of Central Asia’s major rivers and historically one of the Aral Sea’s two main feeder rivers. In this region it meets the open Mirzachul plain.
en.see: Look for reed beds, open water and broad horizons from accessible public stretches of the riverbank.
en.tip: Choose a specific public viewpoint before leaving. This card represents the wider river landscape.

uz.name: Sirdaryo bo‘yi
uz.history: Sirdaryo Markaziy Osiyoning yirik daryolaridan biri va tarixan Orol dengizini suv bilan ta’minlagan ikki asosiy daryodan biridir. Viloyatda daryo manzarasi Mirzacho‘l tekisligi bilan tutashadi.
uz.see: Qamishzor, ochiq suv va keng ufqni jamoat uchun ochiq qirg‘oq nuqtalaridan tomosha qilish mumkin.
uz.tip: Bu manzara butun hududga oid. Borishdan oldin ochiq va qulay tomosha nuqtasini tanlang.

en.name: Rabati Malik
en.history: Built in the 11th century under the Qarakhanid ruler Shams al-Mulk, Rabati Malik served travellers on the trade route between Bukhara and Samarkand.
en.see: The surviving entrance portal and the cistern across the road show how caravan shelter and water supply worked together.
en.tip: Plan to see both structures and use a designated crossing where available.

uz.name: Raboti Malik
uz.history: Qoraxoniy hukmdori Shams ul-Mulk davrida XI asrda qurilgan karvonsaroy Buxoro va Samarqandni bog‘lagan savdo yo‘lidagi bekat bo‘lgan.
uz.see: Saqlangan mahobatli peshtoq va yo‘lning narigi tomonidagi sardoba karvonlar uchun boshpana va suv ta’minoti qanday bog‘langanini ko‘rsatadi.
uz.tip: Ikkala obidani birga rejalashtiring. Qarama-qarshi tomonga o‘tishda belgilangan yo‘ldan foydalaning.

en.name: Nurata Chashma
en.history: The Chashma complex developed around a spring in Nurata. The ruins of Nur Fortress on the hill above it are traditionally associated with Alexander the Great.
en.see: See the spring pool, domed buildings and fortress remains. The hill opens onto views of Nurata and the steppe beyond.
en.tip: Respect local pilgrimage customs and wear shoes suited to uneven ground if climbing toward the fortress.

uz.name: Nurota Chashmasi
uz.history: Chashma majmuasi Nurotadagi buloq atrofida shakllangan ziyorat maskani. Tepalikdagi qadimiy Nur qal’asi an’anada Iskandar Zulqarnayn bilan bog‘lanadi.
uz.see: Buloq hovuzi, gumbazli binolar va qal’a qoldiqlarini ko‘ring. Tepalikdan Nurota va uning atrofidagi dasht manzarasi ochiladi.
uz.tip: Ziyorat odobiga rioya qiling. Qal’a tomonga borishda quruq va notekis yo‘lga mos poyabzal tanlang.

en.name: Savitsky Museum
en.history: Founded in 1966, the I. V. Savitsky State Museum of Art brings together Karakalpak applied arts and major examples of 20th-century avant-garde art.
en.see: Alongside the paintings, make time for textiles, jewellery and other examples of local craftsmanship.
en.tip: Check the museum’s official information for galleries that are open and exhibitions on view.

uz.name: Savitskiy muzeyi
uz.history: I. V. Savitskiy nomidagi davlat san’at muzeyi 1966-yilda tashkil etilgan. U qoraqalpoq amaliy san’ati va XX asr avangard asarlarini o‘zida jamlagan.
uz.see: Rangtasvir zallari bilan birga to‘qimachilik, zargarlik va xalq amaliy san’ati namunalariga vaqt ajrating.
uz.tip: Qaysi zallar ochiqligi va joriy ko‘rgazmalarni muzeyning rasmiy manbasidan tekshiring.

en.name: Moynaq Ship Graveyard
en.history: Fishing vessels sit on dry ground near the former Aral Sea port. They tell the story of a fishing town whose shoreline retreated as the sea shrank.
en.see: Examine the exposed hulls and former seabed, then visit the museum for more context on the human and environmental history.
en.tip: Plan a separate excursion from Nukus and bring water and sun protection for the exposed site.

uz.name: Mo‘ynoq kemalar qabristoni
uz.history: Sobiq Orol porti yaqinida quruqlikda qolgan baliqchilik kemalari namoyish etiladi. Ular Orolning qisqarishi va Mo‘ynoq baliqchilik tarixining moddiy izlaridir.
uz.see: Kema korpuslari va sobiq dengiz tubini tomosha qiling. Muzey tashrifi manzaraning ekologik va insoniy tarixini tushunishga yordam beradi.
uz.tip: Nukusdan alohida safar rejalashtiring. Ochiq maydon uchun suv va quyoshdan himoya vositalarini oling.
